Professional fashion photograph, hip statue portrait. Where a sculpted form comes to an end at the thighs, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off. Generous spacing so every figure reads clearly, nobody's arms crossing a neighbour. Every sculpture stands directly on the floor on its own two rounded tips, with the polished floor visible beneath and around them and no pedestal, so no figure floats in the air.

Every woman below is built exactly like #1 in everything not restated for her (same vessel construction, glass finish, boundary line, water behaviour, physique and pose); only her water level, water colour, contents and glass tint differ.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult French woman — fair natural skin with a light dewy finish, softly brushed natural brows, a barely-there brown liner and fluttering lashes, no eyeshadow, soft natural colour on the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a single bold classic red lip with a soft matte finish, an unbothered, effortless expression, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in low bun. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Physique: A colossal chest, a waist that pulls in sharply beneath it, wide flaring hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped.
#1 Body: From a straight line at the height of her armpits down, her whole body — chest, belly, hips, both arms from the upper arm down, both hands and both distinct thighs — is a sculpted vessel of extremely thin, crystal-clear glass in the exact shape of her body, completely empty: the vessel holds no water, no liquid and no objects of any kind, only clear air inside its sealed hollow. The vessel is her body itself, not a shell worn around a body, with no human body, skin, flesh or organs inside it, so the backdrop is plainly visible straight through it. The glass is unmistakably glass but extraordinarily thin and transparent: a single hair-thin, polished shell carrying only a faint tint of its own colour, like a delicate coloured film — the colour deepens only slightly along its thin rims and where the glass curves edge-on, while the face of every surface stays almost perfectly clear — so delicate that it is almost invisible, revealed by bright specular reflections sliding along every curved surface, sharp white highlights, fine refraction edges along its thin rims and tiny bubbles trapped in the glass itself; the backdrop and its light sources are seen straight through the vessel with almost no distortion. Her chest, belly, hips, arms and both thighs keep their exact sculpted shapes as clear glass outlines, and a clean glass rim runs along the boundary where the vessel meets her real skin at the armpit line. A short way down her thighs, just below the hip line, each thigh individually curves inward and seals shut into its own smooth, rounded, closed tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip — both sealed rounded tips rest side by side directly on the floor, touching it, with a soft contact shadow where each tip meets the floor and no gap beneath them; the sculpture stands on the floor on its own two tips and nothing floats in the air. Her body below the armpit line is a transparent material that light passes through; her face, ears, neck, shoulders and upper chest stay opaque living flesh. Her glass is tinted pale emerald-green.

#2: A strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — pale, almost translucent skin, heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips, a hollow, half-lidded expression, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape.
#2 Physique: A colossal, statuesque chest, a broad heavy torso and wide statuesque hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped, all on a grand imperial scale.
#2 Body: From a straight line at the height of her armpits down, her whole body — chest, belly, hips, both arms from the upper arm down, both hands and both distinct thighs — is a sculpted vessel of extremely thin, crystal-clear glass in the exact shape of her body, filled completely to the brim with vividly coloured citrine-gold water, so nothing is hollow and there is no air gap. A short way down her thighs, just below the hip line, each thigh individually curves inward and seals shut into its own smooth, rounded, closed tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip — both sealed rounded tips rest side by side directly on the floor, touching it, with a soft contact shadow where each tip meets the floor and no gap beneath them; the sculpture stands on the floor on its own two tips and nothing floats in the air. #4 Physique: A giant hourglass frame flaring at both ends — broad shoulders, a colossal chest projecting past them, a big round belly, hips as broad as the shoulders, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped.

The vessel holds ONE single world, kept entirely within the water below the waterline, nothing floating above it: a spring evening: hundreds of pale pink cherry-blossom petals drifting slowly in the coral-pink water.
